instruction: Grab the beige circular blade fan with the left arm and position it on the Brown mat facing the robot.

source.instruction: Grab the beige circular blade fan with the left arm and position it on the Brown mat facing the robot.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the fan, which was at x = -10 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper right and forward towards the fan around (-7, -13, 94.5).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+23, +6, +0) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -13, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient left gripper pointing down to grasp the fan rim from above.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -13, 95) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper by 5 cm to z = 90 and close gripper to grasp the fan.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -5) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan; closed the gripper (opening 0.34: holding the fan)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -13, 90) opening 0.34; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift fan by 5 cm to z = 95 for transport.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +5) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -13, 95) opening 0.35; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper to (-23, -16) over the brown mat and rotate yaw -90 degrees so the fan faces forward/robot.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-16, -3, -0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-23, -16, 95) opening 0.35; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper slightly by 1 cm to z = 94.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -1) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-23, -16, 94) opening 0.35; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to table height (z = 90.5) and release the gripper to place the fan.
